{"id":1918833626,"question_id":815,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 1 week","timestamp":1771066924,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1918833626/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Champagne Tower","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    double byrec(int poured, int i , int j)\n    {\n        //base case\n        if(i < 0 or j < 0) return 0.0;\n        if(i == 0 and j == 0) return poured;\n\n        //ek case hum solve karenge\n        double left_glass = (byrec(poured , i-1 , j-1) - 1) / 2.0;\n        double right_glass = (byrec(poured , i-1 , j) - 1) / 2.0;\n\n        if(left_glass < 0) left_glass = 0.0;\n        if(right_glass < 0) right_glass = 0.0;\n\n        return left_glass + right_glass;\n    }\n\n    double champagneTower(int poured, int query_row, int query_glass) {\n        return min(1.0 , byrec(poured , query_row , query_glass));\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"champagne-tower","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1697}
